title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30352: add SkipNewExpirationDateCheck to OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot
summary: A new parameter SkipNewExpirationDateCheck was added to the OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot event, allowing subscribers to bypass the mandatory New Expiration Date validation during item journal posting without affecting other logic.
key_points: Adds var SkipNewExpirationDateCheck parameter to the OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot integration event in codeunit 22
Subscribers can set it to true to skip only the New Expiration Date TestField check
Avoids using OnBeforeCheckExpirationDate IsHandled, which would require replicating the procedure and skip downstream events
Parameter defaults to false; adding it is non-breaking for existing subscribers
Mirrored in W1 and the ES, APAC, CH, RU and IT layers
